newsitem.title: USA: Tenneco Inc Q1 oper shr $0.44 vs $0.34.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco Inc Q1 oper shr $0.44 vs $0.34.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: 1997 Q1 First Call estimate was $0.38 a share.
1996 Q1 excludes $435 million, or $2.55 a share, of income from discontinued operations. Including the income, 1996 Q1 net was $495 million, or $2.89 a share.

The discontinued operations figure includes $77 million or $0.45 a share from the energy business, $19 million or $0.11 a share from the shipbuilding business, and a gain from the sale of the remaining stock of Case Corp along with equity in Case's loss through the sale date of $339 million or $1.99 a share.
All results are restated to reflect a restructured Tenneco formed in December 1996 following the spin-off of Newport News Shipbuilding and the merger of Tenneco Energy with El Paso Energy.
